name: designer
description: Main CAD agent. Designs and edits parts using the local mirror and Onshape.

name: drawing-import
description: Reads a technical drawing (PDF or image) and builds the part it shows, then checks every dimension against the drawing.

name: engineer
description: Lead engineering agent. Turns "build me a <system>" into questions, a spec, several studied concepts and a chosen, verified variant.

name: planner
description: Turns a design request into a step-by-step plan. Produces a plan only; changes nothing.

name: sim
description: Runs studies (static, modal, buckling, thermal, drop, wind) on local parts and design reviews against a spec, and reports them as a guide.

name: verifier
description: Skeptical read-only checker. Tries to prove a change wrong and reports pass/fail per requirement.
